major_cooldowns.name: Dancing Rune Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown, then press Blood Boil and Marrowrend inside the window so every rune weapon copies Blood Plague and pads Bone Shield.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 49028 is the cast id seen in all 5 sampled parses; 81256 is the matching self aura and is what the buff-based checks read.

major_cooldowns.name: Reaper's Mark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown and always just ahead of Dancing Rune Weapon, and spend your Exterminate charges before the mark detonates.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Deathbringer only. 439843 is the castable row, 434765 is the passive/talent row; neither shows in the sampled parses because the field played San'layn.

major_cooldowns.name: Consumption
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Empower it to rank 1 whenever Dancing Rune Weapon is not active, and to rank 3 the instant you exit Dancing Rune Weapon on multiple targets.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1263824 is the castable row, 1263825 is the passive row. Not pressed in the sampled parses, but the guide lists it as a button in every priority.

major_cooldowns.name: Raise Dead
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Resummon the ghoul off the global cooldown every time Raise Dead comes back up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 46585 is the cast id seen in all 5 sampled parses; 46584 and 52150 share the name.

rule.description: Keep Bone Shield rolling at all times
rule.action: Press Marrowrend before Bone Shield runs low, or Death's Caress when you cannot reach the target.

rule.description: Keep Essence of the Blood Queen stacked
rule.action: Press Vampiric Strike before the buff runs out so the stacks carry into your next Dancing Rune Weapon.

rule.description: Blood Plague stays on your target
rule.action: Reapply it with Blood Boil, and land one inside Dancing Rune Weapon so each rune weapon adds its own copy.
Drop a fresh Death and Decay whenever the buff is down or Crimson Scourge procs, and fight inside it.

rule.description: Open Dancing Rune Weapon into Blood Boil
rule.action: Pre-place Death and Decay, then open Dancing Rune Weapon into Blood Boil before your first Vampiric Strikes and Death Strike.

rule.description: Death Strike before Runic Power caps
rule.action: Spend down with Death Strike instead of pressing another Heart Strike near the cap.
